name: The Aurora Botanic Conservatory
description: A greenhouse where bioluminescent plants emit soft pastel glows, their leaves shift colors with the dancing aurora borealis outside, creating an ever‑changing living light show.
prompt: A breathtaking Aurora Botanic Conservatory: towering glass walls framing bioluminescent plants that pulse with pastel hues, synchronized to the shimmering aurora borealis outside, intricate botanical details, ethereal lighting, hyperrealistic, immersive natural wonder.
caption: Step into a living aurora—where plants breathe color and the night sky dances within walls 🌿🌌.
